notes: cite.py --check 11.7.4 "The name of this method may be referenced in the invocation of a method" -> OK. INVOKE / inline invocation resolve the method by its (externalized) name against the instance/factory roster of the object's class and its superclasses; many 2002 goldens (oo_hello, oo_method_args, oo_self, oo_inherit) invoke methods by name at run time. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (METHOD-ID is part of the OO facility introduced by COBOL 2002; absent at 1985)
